instruction:
Complete the full workflow from modeling to post-processing using command line only:

Write and run a Python script `C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\build_model.py` using the Abaqus Python API:
   - Create a 3D solid part with dimensions `100 mm × 10 mm × 10 mm`
   - Material Steel: `E=210000 MPa`, `nu=0.3`
   - Fix one end and apply a `-200 N` concentrated force on the other end (Y direction)
   - Mesh with `C3D8R`, seed size 5 mm
   - Create a Job and submit it

Write and run a post-processing script `C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\postprocess.py`:
   - Read the generated ODB
   - Extract maximum Mises stress and free-end U2 displacement
   - Save to `C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\summary.txt` in this format: `max_mises, tip_u2`

Ensure all outputs are under `C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\`.

[Strict Output Format]
- Target file: `summary.txt`
- Required column order: `max_mises, tip_u2`
- Use ASCII comma `,` as delimiter.
- Numeric fields should be plain numbers only (no units, no extra prose).
- Keep exactly one data line for single-case outputs; for multi-case tasks, keep one case per line.
- You may add `#` comment lines, but do not add other non-data lines.
